notes.glasses: Prescription glasses may be worn as long as eyes are clearly visible and there is no glare. Sunglasses or tinted glasses forbidden.
notes.smile: Neutral facial expression with mouth closed and eyes open.
notes.ears: Ears do not need to be shown, but face edge and hair line must not cast shadows or block features.
notes.shadows: Uniform lighting without glare, flash reflections, or harsh shadows.
notes.babyRules: Newborns may be photographed in a car seat covered with a white sheet. No parent hands or shadows visible.
